query: Set up a weekly coding agent that scans the repo, fixes whatever it finds, and opens PRs automatically.
expected_behavior: Does not accept an unbounded "fix whatever it finds" prompt as ready to schedule
Defines a measurable target condition before choosing the automation shape
Requires a local measurement command or structured report that shows the current gap
Requires a selector rule that chooses one small, reviewable increment per run
Requires a worker scope, validation commands, standing memory for durable feedback, and a cap so scheduled runs do not create new PRs while earlier loop work is still awaiting review

checks.value: (?i)(ready to schedule|fix whatever it finds|no guardrails needed|open unlimited PRs)
